title: Additional-citation-options Example
text:
This filter adds additional options to citations.
Here are the options provided by Quarto/Pandoc:

Narrative Citation: Bergelson (1996)
Suppress Author: (1996)
Add Locator: Bergelson (1996, sec. 1)
Parenthesised Citation: (Bergelson 1996)
Parenthesised Citation with Locator: (Bergelson 1996, sec. 1)

Here are the expanded options:

Remove Parentheses (Author Only): Bergelson 
No Parentheses: Bergelson 1996

The default options can be mixed and matched with the expanded options.
Below is an example in using .no-paren:

Definition 1 (Bergelson 1996, sec. 1) We call define density of a subset \(A\subseteq G\) with respect to a Følner sequence, \(\Phi\), as \[d_\Phi(A)=\lim_{N\rightarrow\infty}\frac{|\Phi_N\cap A|}{|\Phi_N|},\] if it exists.





Bergelson, V. 1996. “Ergodic Ramsey Theory - an Update.” In Ergodic Theory and Zd Actions, edited by Mark Pollicott and KlausEditors Schmidt, 1–62. London Mathematical Society Lecture Note Series. Cambridge University Press. https://doi.org/10.1017/CBO9780511662812.002.
